newsitem.title: USA: AT&T says will launch new toll-free number.
newsitem.headline: AT&T says will launch new toll-free number.

text.p: AT&T Corp. said Monday it plans to introduce a new toll-free prefix in one year to meet a growing demand for toll-free services.

A year ago, AT&T created an 888 toll-free code to supplement a dwindling supply of 800 numbers. The company said those new numbers are being consumed so quickly that it is working to create another pool of available numbers using an 877 code.

"Of 7.78 million available combinations available, 7.71 million, or 99.9 percent, are working, reserved or otherwise taken from the pool of available numbers," AT&T said of the original batch of 800 numbers.
In addition, 3.3 million of the possible 8 million 888 numbers have also been taken, the company said.
"This means the industry could exhaust the supply of 888 numbers as soon as next year," the company added.
The next code, 877, is scheduled to be operational by April 4, the company said.
